text:
deploy-bot: Canary rollout 2024-06-03T03:12:03Z - model=redwood-large-v2 canary=15% p95=220ms (threshold=180ms). error_rate=0.32%. Recommended action: AUTO-ROLLBACK.
sam: seeing the p95 spike, also noticing tokenization time drift in traces.
lina: confirmed — errors jump started ~03:05, mostly gen endpoint. stack traces show KV cache misses and retry storms.
ops-jen: quick question — if deploy-bot triggers auto-rollback, does that affect dedicated pools? (we need to notify impacted customers)
sam: auto-rollback only reverts canary traffic to previous version (v1.9.1). dedicated/reserved pools unaffected unless we explicitly roll them.
mike: can we hold the auto-rollback for 10m? want to gather a few more samples and try a targeted config toggle first.
kai: I can open a pin PR and a short rollback runbook. If we decide to rollback, I’ll execute and draft the customer blurb.
deploy-bot: Reminder: set `rollback=false` in release config within 5m to suppress automatic rollback. Otherwise auto-rollback will proceed at 03:14:03Z.
sam: I'm applying `rollback:false` to the canary now — reason: investigation + manual decide. Command: `ci/deploy update --canary --set rollback=false`
ops-jen: accepted. Run decision rule: if error_rate > 0.5% OR p95 > 200ms consistently for 10m -> manual rollback immediate. Otherwise keep canary but escalate to infra.
lina: starting kernel-selection bisection and KV cache telemetry. Will post results in this thread.
kai: drafting customer note: "We observed elevated latency in a canary for redwood-large-v2. We're investigating; canary may be rolled back. No action required from customers." Will share short and long versions.
mike: also check release notes — need to mark v2 as rolled-back if we revert. I’ll prepare a quick changelog entry and the PR to pin.
sam: runbook snippet for manual rollback:
```
# manual rollback to v1.9.1 (canary only)
./deploy rollback --service=inference --version=v1.9.1 --scope=canary
./ops/notify --channel=cs --template=canary-rollback
monitor p95/errors for 10m
```
ops-jen: +1 to that runbook. Assigning roles: sam=exec, kai=comms, lina=diagnostics, mike=release notes.
lina: preliminary diagnostic: kernel-choice flag `use_fast_kernels=true` correlates with higher KV miss rate on our canary hosts.
sam: if lina's bisection confirms, prefer to revert the kernel change rather than model version unless necessary.
kai: customer short note posted to cs-digest draft. Waiting for final decision.
deploy-bot: Auto-rollback suppressed by operator at 03:12:45Z (override: rollback=false). Auto action will resume at 03:17:45Z unless manually changed.
sam: decision checklist: (1) wait 10m window, (2) if p95 stays >200ms or errors >0.5% -> manual rollback to v1.9.1, (3) else continue canary and roll forward with kernel patch in next rollout.
ops-jen: agreed. I'll notify oncall and CS after 10m if we rollback. If we keep canary, we'll PR a kernel-compat hotfix and schedule a short maintenance window.
mike: prepping release note bullet and changelog now. will tag PR with `rollback-communicated` once done.
kai: comms ready to go, will hold sending until we execute.
sam: thanks all — keep updates in-thread. :thumbsup:
